title: Full nationality axis in both loan contexts
description:
Feature: Full nationality coverage in loan contexts

Scenario: Every published nationality has a loan-decision result
Given the thirteen nationalities already measured on the expanded nationality axis
When the pre-registered small-business-loan study and loan-narrative study run
Then each nationality has an independently replayable result in each loan context
And the existing five-nationality result remains preserved as its own earlier study

Scenario: Nationality remains one public characteristic
Given the completed loan-context studies
When the leaderboard is generated
Then all nationality results appear under the Nationality characteristic with their context and coverage visible
And no loan context appears as a separate characteristic
